title: Repertoire
intro: Build your personal opening plan move by move. Save what you want to play and the replies you expect from your opponents.

whatIs.title: What is a repertoire?
whatIs.body: It is your own map for the opening: your moves, the opponent replies you want to prepare for, and your notes for each position.
whatIs.reassurance: You do not need to prepare everything at once. Start with one opening and let it grow.

library.title: Your repertoires
library.subtitle: Keep separate plans for the openings you actually want to play.
library.emptyBody: Create a repertoire for White or Black. Inside it, simply play moves on the board to save your first line.
library.noFilterBody: Try another colour or create a new repertoire.
library.deleteConfirm: Delete ‘{{name}}’ and all its saved lines?

create.title: Create a repertoire
create.help: Name the opening or plan in a way that makes sense to you.
create.name: Name

white.title: White
white.help: Your plan when you move first

guide.title: How this editor works
guide.back: Go back to an earlier position

guide.notes: Write down what you want to remember

editor.whitePurpose: Build the positions and responses you want when you have White.
editor.blackPurpose: First enter White's expected moves, then save the replies you want with Black.
editor.baseHelp: Every position is saved automatically. The base marks where you want to resume or study this repertoire when you open it again.
editor.continuationsHelp: Saved moves you can continue with
editor.noContinuationsBody: Play a legal move on the board. It will be added automatically.
editor.blackFirstHint: Preparing Black? Play the White move you expect first, then enter your Black response.
editor.moveHint: Drag a piece or click the origin and destination squares. New legal moves are saved automatically.
editor.notesHelp: These notes belong only to the position you are viewing.
editor.notesPlaceholder: What is the idea here? What response are you expecting? What should you avoid?
editor.notePlan: The plan or idea behind your move
editor.noteResponse: The opponent reply you expect most often
editor.noteMistake: A typical mistake or detail to remember
